scripts.install:all: node scripts/npm-in.mjs server install && node scripts/npm-in.mjs client install
scripts.build: node scripts/npm-in.mjs server run build && node scripts/npm-in.mjs client run build
scripts.typecheck: node scripts/npm-in.mjs server run typecheck && node scripts/npm-in.mjs client run typecheck
scripts.test: node scripts/npm-in.mjs server run test && node scripts/npm-in.mjs client run test
scripts.check: npm run check:module-case && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run test:scripts && npm run build
scripts.audit:all: npm audit --audit-level=moderate && node scripts/npm-in.mjs server audit --audit-level=moderate && node scripts/npm-in.mjs client audit --audit-level=moderate
